title: AI结构性变动：多模态自我改进、低精度量化与分布式推理驱动跨行业渗透加速
core_insight: 新一代多模态自我改进模型与高效量化/分布式推理的同步突破，既提升了模型能力与推理效率，又大幅降低成本，推动AI在企业、法律及航空、医疗、金融等行业的快速渗透。

dimension_texts.technology: DeepMind推出Gemini 4 Carbon，提升多模态理解与推理规模；Trinity论文展示递归自我改进的能力框架，暗示模型自我提升上限正在被重新定义。 KORA提出确定性优先的执行控制，允许系统在无需推理时直接跳过模型调用；Trinity引入能力驱动的递归自我改进范式，改变传统单轮训练流程。 Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model The Trinity: Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents KORA: Deterministic-First Execution Control for AI Workloads
dimension_texts.infrastructure: KORA通过提前判定推理必要性显著降低不必要的计算开销；ResCom的激活残差补偿进一步降低低比特量化后的精度损失，使LLM在边缘设备上的部署成本下降。 FP8量化模型展示硬件层面效率提升，Azure收入显示云算力需求持续增长；暂无新硬件发布，成本下降主要来源于算法层面的效率提升。 KORA: Deterministic-First Execution Control for AI Workloads tencent/Hy-SimulMT-30B-A3B-FP8 Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion ResCom: Activation Residual Compensation for Large Language Model Quantization Distributed LLM Inference via Communication-Efficient Speculative Decoding
dimension_texts.application: OpenAI与ServiceNow的深度集成、Legora的法律Agentic OS以及Chrome AI Autofill扩展至Gmail；同时出现面向航空（远程火箭着陆RL、航空设计GAN）、医疗影像（肺结节3D网络、糖尿病视网膜病变、MedJev零样本医学决策）以及金融（FinLLM‑KG）等新场景的AI研究。 AI agents开始替代传统SaaS的手工数据录入与合同审查流程；LLM驱动的医学诊断与金融情感分析模型展示出可替代传统规则或小模型系统的潜力。 OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows Legora is building the agentic operating system for legal work Chrome’s AI-powered Autofill can now dig through your Gmail to fill out forms Curriculum-Driven Deep Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Far-Range Rocket Landing Condition-Enhanced Generative Adversarial Network for Aerodynamic Configuration Design of Commercial Aircraft MedJev: Evaluating Zero-Shot System-One Decision Making in Medicine FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading From Slices to Volumes: Comparing 2D, 2.5D, and 3D Residual Networks for Pulmonary Nodule Malignancy-Risk Classification
dimension_texts.capital: 资本继续向企业AI服务倾斜：Microsoft从OpenAI实现10亿美元收入，Anthropic推出AI支出透明工具预示即将IPO，Numeracle获28M美元融资聚焦AI驱动的通信防护。 OpenAI与Microsoft的深度商业化让AI模型估值进入十亿美元级别；Anthropic的IPO准备提升行业整体估值基准。 Microsoft深化与OpenAI的收入共享模式；Google在AI Search广告全球扩张并开放Gemini给更多开发者；DeepMind发布Gemini 4 Carbon以抢占高端模型市场。 Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying Exclusive: Numeracle Raises $28M To Keep Legitimate Business Calls From Spam Label
